SIGNALS.name: World Labs
SIGNALS.summary: World Labs says it is joining AMD, aiming to speed up its work on AI for the spatial and physical world.

SIGNALS.name: OpenAI Developers
SIGNALS.summary: OpenAI Developers says the DevDay keynote is the next day and shares a link to watch it.

SIGNALS.name: Claude
SIGNALS.summary: Claude Sonnet 5.5 is out as the second model in the Claude 5.5 family. Anthropic says it runs over 30% faster than Sonnet 5 and costs up to 30% less for most work.

SIGNALS.name: TestingCatalog News
SIGNALS.summary: Manus launched Manus 2.0, with a new, more efficient agent architecture called Cascade, cloud computers, event-triggered automations and an updated Manus Studio desktop app.

SIGNALS.name: NVIDIA
SIGNALS.summary: NVIDIA launched the Open Agent Safety Platform to control what AI agents can access and do, pairing its open-source OpenShell runtime with the Sentry reference design.

SIGNALS.name: Mark Zuckerberg
SIGNALS.summary: Meta is starting Meta Enterprise Platform, a new business that sells its AI stack, including the Muse agent and models, directly to companies and developers.

SIGNALS.name: Indian Tech & Infra
SIGNALS.summary: Google is testing a Buy button in Gemini and AI Mode in India that sends select users to a Flipkart checkout without leaving Google's AI experience. Wider rollout is planned.

SIGNALS.name: NBC Bay Area
SIGNALS.summary: OpenAI says it has paused training of its latest AI models as reports grow of AI agents acting outside their intended limits.

SIGNALS.name: TestingCatalog News
SIGNALS.summary: Spotted in ChatGPT: references to an upcoming always-on OpenAI assistant that appears to be called "o". Unconfirmed by OpenAI.
